Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Lists the topics and subtopics covered in this module — including question types, the Content Source Selector, question banks, exporting, assignment tasks, and assessment alignment — giving learners and instructors an at-a-glance map of what the module contains.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to Quiz and Assignment Generation
Artifacts.Description: Introduces the purpose and benefits of generating quizzes and assignments within PreseMaker, explaining how automated assessment generation saves time and improves relevance; learners read this to understand why and how the platform's assessment tools matter before using them.

Artifacts.Name: Understanding Question Types
Artifacts.Description: Explains the main question types supported by PreseMaker — multiple choice, true/false, and short answer — including when and why to use each type to match the cognitive demands of a learning outcome; learners use this to make informed decisions when designing assessments.

Artifacts.Name: Using the Content Source Selector
Artifacts.Description: Describes what the Content Source Selector is, where to find it, and how to use it to focus quiz and assignment generation on specific topics within a module; learners follow this as a step-by-step guide to ensure generated questions are relevant and well-scoped.

Artifacts.Name: Building and Generating Question Banks
Artifacts.Description: Explains what a question bank is and walks through how to build and generate one in PreseMaker, covering how to organise and reuse assessment items across quizzes and exams; instructors use this to create a reusable pool of questions rather than writing new items from scratch each time.

Artifacts.Name: Exporting to LMS-Compatible Formats
Artifacts.Description: Covers how to export a generated question bank into LMS-compatible formats so that questions can be delivered, rendered, and scored inside a Learning Management System; learners and instructors follow this to complete the workflow from PreseMaker to their live course environment.

Artifacts.Name: Creating Structured Assignment Tasks
Artifacts.Description: Guides users through creating well-structured assignment tasks in PreseMaker, including how to write clear prompts, set precise expectations, and anchor tasks to learning outcomes; instructors use this to design assignments that provide meaningful evidence of learner achievement.

Artifacts.Name: Aligning Assessments with the Module Plan
Artifacts.Description: Explains how to ensure assessments align with a module's learning outcomes and content coverage, describing why misalignment undermines assessment validity and how to check and correct it in PreseMaker; instructors use this to audit and improve the coherence of their assessment strategy.
